quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Holdings semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-06-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half to September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 67,830 million (+13.2% YoY), operating profit JPY 15,187 million (+22.2%), ordinary profit JPY 15,078 million (+21.4%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 11,022 million (+19.7%). Electronics segment sales JPY 46,346 million (+8.9%), segment profit JPY 13,794 million (+14.5%): semiconductor package substrate materials volumes rose as demand grew, centered on products for memory; rigid board materials volumes rose on automotive materials in the China region and smartphone-related materials; display-related dry film volumes fell; the stronger yen reduced sales (average JPY 146.5 per US dollar vs JPY 152.3). Medical & Pharmaceutical segment sales JPY 18,451 million (+22.4%), segment profit JPY 2,426 million (+160.6%). H1 R&D expenses JPY 3,762 million, of which Electronics JPY 3,231 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 67,830 million (+13.2%); operating profit JPY 15,187 million (+22.2%); Electronics sales JPY 46,346 million (+8.9%)

quarterly_data.signal: During the first half the company drew up a new medium-term management plan covering the fiscal years ending March 2026 to March 2031; it set a new ROE target of 30% for the fiscal year ending March 2031, replacing the 18% target of its long-term vision Beyond Imagination 2030.
quarterly_data.figure: ROE target 30% for FY ending March 2031 (previously 18%)
